method.kind: EXACT ORIGINAL CAMERA PLUS ACTUAL R49 TRIANGLES, APPROX HALF-RES SOFTWARE Z RASTER
method.limitations: CPU depth is approximate; renderer clipping/fog/culling/draw order differs from genuine native. Surface triangles may have subpixel or native-specific differences. Does not prove all possible alternative channels impossible.

boundedAlternativeScreenSurvey.meaning: A visible outboard outlet is not categorically impossible, but no near original-source surface point in sampled grid was visible across all three. These far candidate points do not by themselves provide believable source→fall→receiver.

criticalDecision.rationale: R61 original y93 source/water outlet is in front of original road skin at all three projective samples. Projected y93 protected water surface appears only at 66.35 once only 0.75s remains before native B51; was 0 at the first two ~1.9s and 1.5s windows. Blender reproduction of R61 geometry has a high risk of producing ART-invisible hydraulic causality.
criticalDecision.limits: Not a true new GL screenshot or proof that any new outboard hydraulic facility is impossible. No new Blender authored in R62 and no person playtested.
criticalDecision.next: Use a genuinely grounded source-native original camera/depth test or a revised physically connected outboard route without modifying protected water/road/camera. If none is demonstrably readable, hold and request separate permission for scope-changing protected changes only when justified. Do not make a fake safety portal, recolor or repaint the A-frame.
